canada.title: Family of missing Penticton senior with dementia pleads for information
canada.summary: The family of a missing Penticton senior with dementia are desperate for answers. The 72-year-old has not been been seen or heard from in weeks. Police believe he may have travelled northbound along the KVR trail between McCulloch trestle and Naramata.

canada.title: Manitoba Progressive Conservatives say they won't cut services, spending if elected in 2027
canada.summary: Manitoba's Progressive Conservatives say they would make no cuts to provincial services or funding if they formed government, even though the Opposition party accuses the NDP government of excessive spending.

canada.title: 120-year-old church bell weighing 300 pounds stolen from belfry in rural Manitoba
canada.summary: The case of the stolen church bell has police sounding an alarm — and scratching their heads.

canada.title: City of Edmonton searches for ways to curb housing crisis as need rises
canada.summary: More people in the Edmonton Metropolitan Region are at risk of facing inadequate housing conditions in the coming years as the city grows, according to a new city report.

canada.title: Halifax broadcaster Todd Veinotte dies at 57
canada.summary: Veinotte was known in Halifax for his talk radio show on News 957. His obituary stated he worked more than 25 years in journalism and media, which also included newspapers and television. His obituary says he died "following his journey with Parkinson's disease."

canada.title: Settlement approved in N.S. First Nation class action over non-consensual MRI scans
canada.summary: The lawsuit alleged two Halifax doctors performed some magnetic resonance (MRI) scans on about 60 people from Pictou Landing First Nation without their knowledge or consent. None of the allegations in the lawsuit have been tested in court. The defendants deny the allegations.

canada.title: ‘Such a gift’: Łutselk'e, N.W.T., teacher builds community with pop-up hair salon
canada.summary: There is no set price list at the monthly pop-up hair salon Jennifer Bascomb hosts at Łutselk'e’s local school, but she will accept stories, advice, or even fresh game meat in exchange for her services.

canada.title: Regina city council tables decision on Co-op refinery work camp proposal
canada.summary: Workers and concerned citizens came together at Regina city council to urge the city to not allow a proposed workcamp the Co-op refinery wants to build. Council tabled the motion until 2027, citing unanswered questions.

canada.title: InFocus: Is adopting permanent daylight saving time a mistake?
canada.summary: Many of us know how we feel when it's time to change our clocks. Some provinces and territories have put a stop to it. But is it a good idea?

canada.title: Proposed Saint John data centre could generate tax windfall, critics unconvinced
canada.summary: The study on the proposed Spruce Lake data centre was commissioned by Beacon Data Centers, the company behind the proposal alongside U.S.-based VoltaGrid.

canada.title: Social media chatter can result in ‘twisted’ perception of danger in downtown St. John’s: RNC
canada.summary: The Royal Newfoundland Constabulary is clarifying that St. John’s is, in fact, safe despite social media posts implying the opposite. Compared to 2025, Const. Stephanie Myers said there’s been a 12 per cent decrease in calls for service in downtown this year.

canada.title: Alberta government tables bill to adopt redrawn electoral ridings
canada.summary: The NDP says the changes are an attempt to rig the 2027 election, while the UCP says it's about boosting effective representation and that hybrid ridings already exist in Alberta.

canada.title: Ontario tables new law introducing stronger legal protections for victims of intimate image abuse
canada.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford's government tabled a bill Monday that would create a new legal pathway for victims of intimate image abuse to have those images deleted.
canada.outlet: CBC News + CP24 + Global News + CityNews (CP)

canada.title: Ontario Catholic school teachers vote in favour of strike mandate: union
canada.summary: The union representing 45,000 teachers in Ontario's English Catholic schools says 98 per cent of its members have voted in favour of a strike mandate.

canada.title: No complaint received by ombudsman after children allegedly confined in locker
canada.summary: Quebec's ombudsman's office says it won't be able to investigate or issue recommendations until a parent or student files a complaint.

canada.title: Ontario’s medical regulator pauses safer supply drug changes after legal challenge
canada.summary: Ontario’s medical regulator is hitting pause on implementing a host of changes to the ways doctors prescribe safer supply drugs after it was served with a legal challenge.

canada.title: Man and woman fatally shot in Surrey double homicide
canada.summary: Police officers were called Sunday night to the Walmart parking lot at 88 Avenue and 124 Street, where a man and woman were found suffering from gunshot wounds that proved fatal.

canada.title: 4 people charged with manslaughter after death of 33-year-old in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Three men and one female teenager are facing manslaughter charges in relation to the death of Kyle Andrew Devon Jerome in Winnipeg.
